title: Canonical derived completeness of a completed etale integral line
statement: Let ell be a prime, E a finite extension of Q_ell, and X any scheme. Let H be a sheaf of O_E-modules on the small etale site of X, with an etale covering U_i -> X on which it is isomorphic to the constant regular module O_E. Pull H to the pro-etale site, apply the constant-ring module equivalence, and extend scalars along the canonical constant-to-completion map to obtain M over the actual completed integral coefficient sheaf. Then M[0] is IsSfDerivedComplete: its canonical derived reduction units form the first arrow of a distinguished Roos triangle for its canonical positive quotient tower. No Noetherian, dimension, separatedness, or geometric invertibility hypothesis on X is imposed.

source.place: Lemma 6.8.2(1), Proposition 6.8.4(1), Corollary 5.1.5, Sections 3.5 and 6.5; specialization to an etale-trivial integral line

proof.text: On each given etale chart, comparison inverse image carries H to the constant regular integral module. The constant-ring encoding is the associated-module equivalence. Scalar extension carries the regular module to the completed regular module. All identifications are induced by the given chart isomorphism and the scalar maps, so they commute with restriction to overlaps.

The local regular module in degree zero is K-flat. Its positive derived quotients are the ordinary regular quotient modules and the adjunction units are the coefficient projections. This identification follows by the tensor/restriction adjunction on a generator; it retains the actual maps, not just the isomorphism classes of the quotient objects.

The quotient transitions are epimorphisms and their ordinary inverse limit is the completed regular module. Apply the surjective-tower derived-limit theorem to obtain the distinguished Roos triangle with the actual projections.

Globally form the canonical reduction units and their Roos cone. Exact slice restriction preserves products and identifies that cone with the local cones of the preceding step. Those cones vanish on the trivializing cover, so their homology sheaves vanish globally. Transport the distinguished Roos triangle through this canonical augmentation. This proves the stated completeness predicate, including on the empty scheme.

proof_origin.place: Detailed rank-one argument implementing Lemma 6.8.2(1) and Proposition 6.8.4(1), using Sections 3.5 and 6.5

theorem etaleIntegralLine_derivedComplete
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E]
    [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E] (X : Scheme.{u})
    (H : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology
      (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E))))
    (_hH : ∃ 𝒰 : Scheme.Cover.{u} Scheme.etalePrecoverage X, ∀ i : 𝒰.I₀,
      Nonempty ((Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1}
        (ULift.{u + 1} (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E))) (𝒰.f i)).obj H ≅
        (constantSheaf (𝒰.X i).smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1}
          (ULift.{u + 1} (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E)))).obj
            (ModuleCat.of _ (ULift.{u + 1} (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E))))) :
    let M : scalarReductionSource l E X :=
      SheafOfModules.changeOfRingsOfUniverses
        (R₁ := (constantSheaf (ProEt.topology X) CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj
          (CommRingCat.of (ULift.{u + 1} (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E))))
        (R₂ := completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E X)
        ((sheafCompose (ProEt.topology X)
          (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1})).preimage
            (integralConstantToCompletionOfUniverses l E X))
        ((SheafOfModules.restrictScalars
          (constantModuleHomRingIso (ProEt.topology X)
            (ULift.{u + 1} (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E))).inv).obj
          ((PresheafOfModules.sheafification
            (toSheafify (ProEt.topology X)
              ((Functor.const X.ProEtᵒᵖ).obj
                (RingCat.of (ULift.{u + 1} (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E)))))).obj
            ((ProEtale.finiteCoefficientModulePresheaf X.ProEt
              (ULift.{u + 1} (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E))).obj
              ((ProEtale.comparisonUpperStar _ X).obj H).obj)))
    IsSfDerivedComplete l E X ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj M)
